test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Let us donate the money.

options.text: We are told to donate the money.
Let the money is donated by us.
Let the money be donated by us.
The money was donated by us.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Let the money be donated by us."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The rules for changing an imperative sentence from active to passive voice is as follows:

 
 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The subject of the active sentence becomes the agent (or doer) of the action in the passive sentence.
 
• To form the passive voice, use the auxiliary verb **"be" + past participle of the main verb.**
 
• In this sentence, **"let"** is already in the passive form, so we only need to change the subject and object.
 
• An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form:
 
• Structure:
 
 
• Let + subject + V1 + object. (Active voice)
 
• Let + object + be + past participle of the verb. (Passive voice)
 
• Example: ​
 
 
• *Let us call him. (Active Voice)*
 
• *Let he be called by us. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: *Let the money be donated by us.*
